tr: Do you have a dog? / Yes, his name is Max.
Have you eaten? / Yes, I ate a mango earlier.
Where are my slippers? / Outside, next to the door.
Where are the kids? / They're at Lola's house.
Good morning, Lola! / Good morning to you too, dear. Have you eaten?
How are you, Tita? / I'm fine. And you, how are you?
Hey, Joy! How are you? / I'm okay. You?
Here's your change. / Thank you.
Bless me, Lolo. / God bless you.
Hello, is anyone home? / Please come in.
What's your name? / Bea. You?
Where are you from? / I'm from Cebu, but I live in Manila.
How old are you? / Twenty-one.
Do you speak English? / Yes, but I want to learn Tagalog.
What do you do for work? / I'm a nurse at a hospital in Makati.
Who's that? / That's Kuya Jun, my older brother.
How many siblings do you have? / Two: a brother and a sister.
Tita, this is Juan, my friend. / How are you, Juan? Come in.
Are you married? / Not yet.
Where's Lola? / In the kitchen, cooking sinigang.
How much is this? / Twenty pesos.
Here's the payment. / Thank you. Here's your change.
That's twenty pesos. / Sorry, I don't have small change. I only have a hundred.
How much is it all together? / It's two hundred altogether.
What time is it? / It's three o'clock.
When are you going home? / Tomorrow morning.
What day is it today? / Friday. Finally!
How long is the trip to Batangas? / About three hours.
Have you eaten? / Not yet. I'm actually starving!
Have you eaten, Lola? / Yes, dear. You eat too.
Let's eat! / Thanks, I'm still full.
Is there any water? / Yes, in the fridge.
What would you like? / One coffee, please, and one pandesal.
I'd like to buy something, please! / What can I get you?
How much is that? / Fifty pesos each.
What can I get you, ma'am? / A kilo of mangoes, please.
This is three hundred. / That's so expensive! No discount?
Which one would you like? / I'll just take this one.
Are you still up? / Yes, I can't sleep.
Where's Mom? / Mom is cooking in the kitchen.
Go take a shower. / I already showered earlier.
Is Dad here yet? / Yes, Dad came home a while ago.
Bea, where's the restroom? / Over there, next to the kitchen.
Is the pharmacy near? / Yes, it's close. It's at the corner.
Where are you going, Jun? / To church. Want to come?
Excuse me, where's the hospital? / Just go straight, then turn right at the corner.
Is it still far? / Not anymore. We're almost there.
Stop here, please, right at the side! / Okay.
How much is the fare to Makati? / Fifteen pesos.
Does this go through Manila? / Yes, hop on.
To Makati, please. / Sure, ma'am.
Where does it hurt? / My stomach hurts, Doc.
Why aren't you at work? / I'm sick. I have a fever.
Are you okay? / No, I don't feel well.
May I ask something? / Yes, what is it?
Where do you work? / At a hospital. I'm a nurse.
Do you have work tomorrow? / No. Tomorrow's Saturday.
What's your major? / Nursing. I'm still studying in Manila.
Did you study yesterday? / Yes, I studied at home yesterday.
This is our house. / How beautiful!
Is Tita Baby nice? / Yes, she's kind to everyone.
Which one do you want? / This one. It's bigger than that one.
Who's Carlo? / He's the tall guy over there.
Come on, let's dance! / I'm tired. Maybe tomorrow.
We're going to the mall. Do you want to come along? / Sure, I'll come!
What do you like to do? / I love singing.
Why is Mark so quiet? / He's angry at me.
I'm going to Cebu. / When?
Where are you? / I'm still at home.
Lola, have you eaten yet? / Yes, I've eaten. You?
I want coffee. / Me too.
Is there any water? / There's none.
Are you done? / Not yet.
Do you know Ana? / Yes, I know Ana. She's my friend.
Can you speak Tagalog? / Yes, I can speak Tagalog, but only a little.
I'm going to Boracay tomorrow! / Really? Lucky you!
Lola's adobo is delicious, right? / Yes, so good!
Let's go! / Wait a sec, where's my phone?
Where's Mark? / I don't know.
It's so hot! Please turn on the AC. / Okay.
Your cooking is delicious, Tita. / Thanks! Have some more.
May I have some more? / Of course! There's plenty.
Eat some more! / Thank you, I'm so full.
I've finished the report. / You're so good at this!
I cleaned the whole house. / You work so hard!
What do you think? / It suits you!
Come in. / Thank you. Your home is beautiful.
Is this Carlo? Your child has gotten so big! / Yes, he's ten now.
Thank you. / Hey, you speak Tagalog!
You speak Tagalog really well! / Thanks, but I'm still learning.
You sing so well! / Not really.
Your handwriting is beautiful, dear. / Not really. Thank you.
What a nice outfit! / Thanks, you too!
You're fun to be with. / You too! Come on, let's eat.
Thanks for tonight. Dinner again on Saturday? / I'd like that too.
Come on, let's dance! / Oh, all right then.
You look so handsome today. / Really? Thanks! My shirt is new.
Sorry, I'm late. / It's okay. You look beautiful tonight.
My name is Liza. / You have a pretty name.
I'm studying Tagalog, Japanese and Spanish. / Oh, you're smart!
You have a lovely voice. / Oh, not really.
You're all dressed up today! Where are you going? / To my cousin's wedding.
You're nice to talk to. / You too. Coffee again tomorrow?
I'm happy to be with you. / Me too.
May I court you? / Why not?
I like Bea, but I'm shy. / Don't be so shy! Talk to her.
Coffee sometime? / Sure, I'd like that.
Are you free on Saturday? / Of course! Where should we go?
I have feelings for you. / Really? Me too!
You're the most beautiful one here. / You're such a smooth talker!
You're really pretty. / Oh, you!
Can I invite you to dinner? / Thanks, but I'm seeing someone.
Are you free tonight? / Sorry, I'm not interested.
I like you, Joy. / Thanks, but we're really just friends.
Hey, Ana! How are you? / Hey! I'm okay.
Hey! That's mine! / Sorry, so it's yours.
The store is already closed. / Too bad! I really wanted to buy something.
There's no school tomorrow! / Yay!
We leave at five tomorrow. / Huh? That's so early!
Let's go! / Wait, I'll just get my bag.
Tired? / Sigh! So much work.
We're here. / Phew, thank goodness!
There's free coffee at the office. / Great!
It's so hot today! / It really is!
Come here, let's eat! / Okay, thanks!
Long live the newlyweds! / Cheers!
There's a cockroach in the kitchen! / Gross!
The jeep left without me. / Serves you right! You took so long.
Come with us. Come on, please! / Okay, I'll come.
Come on! You're so noisy! / Sorry.
Where's the key? / Here!
I'm from Cebu too. / No way! Me too!
Lola, I spilled the coffee. / Jesus, Mary and Joseph! Clean it up right away.
